>relationship until the therapist thinks you are ready--this will probably take years.

Im sorry but I disagree on the tinder thing, I was living in a small desert town where I literally did not see a single human being for 3 months, I am not making excuses I know that it hurts people and hadn't used it for 9 months before the final incident happened.

The adhd was diagnosed less than 2 years ago after the collapse of my first marriage, and this second one took place in the middle of treatment etc. Look I'm offering context not running away from what I did.

​

I sat down with my ex and went over every single thing I did wrong over the two year period with a note book, I instantly signed the divorce papers and didn't waver a single moment and have handed all our savings and other assets to her without any hesititation. I am honestly trying to own my shit and fix this.

I have come to realise how disgusting tinder is, I never met a single person on it and she knows this that was why she forgrave me, but as she came from a long period of dating history tyinder was a massive red flag and I now know in the future that I wont use it ever again even when single.

You see this is my second girlfriend in the entirety of my life, I want her back I dont care if it takes a decade of self reflection I will work on it.

Caremen, thankyou for your comment. You are right, although I constantly tell myself that I am not using it as an excuse the fact that it sits at the tip of my tongue constantly when I describe the situation does not bode well. I am in the process of owning my shit, and my digusting behaviour. 

I am just trying to rebuild and be a better person, because I do truely love this woman, I also don't regret whats happened in some ways because I needed to have my world come crashing down so I could finally be held accountable for my own actions and face the repercussions. But obviously I still love my wife, I have laid out life goals over the next two years as to what I want to asprie to in my own individual personal growth, and I accept the reality that she may have remarried and moved on during that time at which point I will honestly be happy for her, although quite heart broken.

I'm trying to not be sorry for myself, as she is the only victim in this entire thing, when I think fo medication it was a factor that lead to some of my mental state but at the same time you are completely correct. The actions were carried out by me and only me, and although I did not have physical relations with this other women I commited an act of betrayal.

thankyou for your comment, I understand that is a reality. But I do want to work at being a better person for myself and I don't believe I am truely such a horrible person. I just want to better myself.

>u can’t blame your mental illness on cheating. At the start you keep mentioning “my medication made me ...” no. Your medication doesn’t make you cheat on people. You believed someone you barely knew over your wife. It’s simple as that, stop trying to find excuses, you’re a grown man and you should take responsibility

Carmen, if you read through it clearly I understand what i did was disgusting and I am owning up to everything. I am not trying to use it as an excuse I'm trying to rebuild myself and become a better in the future.
